title: Ronaldo says he is not retiring and wants to be punished for leaving Portugal camp
summary: Cristiano Ronaldo said he is not retiring from international football but should be punished by the Portuguese federation for walking out of the national-team camp, accusing head coach Jorge Jesus of twice breaking his word. In a roughly 2,000-word statement, the 41-year-old said Jesus told him he would play 30 minutes against Norway but never used him, and that an agreed clarification was not delivered at a later press conference. Ronaldo apologised to teammates and fans, and said he would be available again after any suspension once fit and scoring for his club.
